PYTHONPATH=host:consumer python -W error::DeprecationWarning - <<'PY'
from boltons.funcutils import FunctionBuilder, inspect_formatargspec, formatargandannotation, wraps
from glom import Auto, Fill, Check, First, Iter, Let, Inspect, T, S, glom, SKIP, STOP

def f(a=1, *, required, option=None):return a,required,option
fb=FunctionBuilder.from_func(f)
assert fb.get_defaults_dict()=={'a':1,'option':None}
assert fb.get_arg_names(only_required=True)==('required',)
fb.body='return a, required, option'
assert fb.get_func()(required=2)==(1,2,None)
@wraps(f)
def wrapped(*args,**kwargs):return f(*args,**kwargs)
assert wrapped(required=2)==(1,2,None)
assert inspect_formatargspec([],kwonlyargs=['b','a'],kwonlydefaults={'a':None})=='(*, b, a=None)'
assert inspect_formatargspec(['x'],varargs='args',varkw='kw',defaults=(2,),annotations={'x':int,'args':float,'kw':str,'return':bool})=='(x: int=2, *args: float, **kw: str) -> bool'
assert formatargandannotation('x', {'x':int}, formatarg=str.upper)=='X: int'
target={'rows':[{'x':0},{'x':1},{'x':2},{'x':3}]}
spec=(Let(rows='rows'), Fill({'label':'rows','values':Auto(('rows',Iter('x').filter().all())), 'saved':S['rows']}))
assert glom(target,spec)=={'label':'rows','values':[1,2,3],'saved':target['rows']}
assert glom(target, ('rows',Iter(Inspect('x',recursive=True,echo=False)).dropwhile(lambda x:x<2).chunked(3,fill=-1).all()))==[[2,3,-1]]
assert glom(range(10),Iter(lambda x:STOP if x==4 else x).all())==[0,1,2,3]
assert glom(range(6),Iter(lambda x:SKIP if x%2 else x).all())==[0,2,4]
assert glom(range(6),Iter().filter(Check(validate=lambda x:x>2)).first())==3
assert glom([1,1,2,3,2],Iter().unique().windowed(2).all())==[(1,2),(2,3)]
assert glom(range(6),Iter().takewhile(lambda x:x<4).slice(1,None,2).all())==[1,3]
assert glom([{'ok':False},{'ok':True}],First('ok'))=={'ok':True}
assert glom(None, (Auto((Let(x=lambda _:42),S['x'])),Fill(('literal',T))))==('literal',42)
print('warning-as-error function and composed glom compatibility checks passed')
PY
